🧠 Crypto News Brief: Risk appetite crept back as soft US jobs data lifted Bitcoin above $65K and ETF inflows held — even as the CLARITY Act slipped to September, and Trump Media's crypto retreat and fresh security fights kept the market on edge. ⚖️ Senate Opens First CLARITY Act Votes After a marathon overnight session, the US Senate moved early Saturday to open the first procedural votes on the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act — the furthest the industry's flagship market-structure bill has ever advanced. With the pre-recess window now missed, its fate rests on a narrow, uncertain path when lawmakers return in September. Read full story 📈 Bitcoin Tops $65K on Weak US Jobs Data Bitcoin climbed back above $65,000 to a month-to-date high after a soft US payrolls report revived bets on Federal Reserve rate cuts, lifting risk assets and sending US stocks to record highs. The move underscored how tightly crypto is now trading with the macro rate outlook. More details 🏛️ Cardano Clears Futures Test for Spot ETF Cardano's CME futures quietly crossed six months of trading on August 9, satisfying the SEC's generic-listing threshold and clearing a key hurdle toward a spot ADA ETF. With Grayscale's application already on file, a decision window could open as soon as late October — though the SEC's past claim that ADA is a security still hangs over any approval. Read more 🏢 Trump Media Scraps $6.4B CRO Treasury Deal Trump Media, Crypto.com and Yorkville mutually scrapped plans for a multibillion-dollar publicly traded CRO treasury company and pared back a project to embed prediction markets in Truth Social. The retreat — with CRO sliding around 8% — is one of the clearest signals yet that 2025's corporate "digital-asset treasury" frenzy has cooled. See details 🕵️ Bybit Sues North Korea Over $1.5B Hack Bybit filed a civil lawsuit in Washington against North Korea, its Reconnaissance General Bureau and the Lazarus Group over last year's $1.5 billion exchange hack, and secured a preliminary injunction freezing identified stolen funds. It is a landmark attempt to use US courts to claw back assets from state-linked crypto crime. Full story 💰 Bitcoin and Ether ETFs Extend Inflow Streak US spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs kept drawing fresh cash into August, with roughly $833 million flowing into Bitcoin funds over seven sessions, led by BlackRock's IBIT and ETHA.
